basis: Already-recorded independent general findings only; no frozen challenge inputs inspected

findings.mechanism: Lexical route fallback selects a code without modeling negation or cardinality
findings.risk: Confidently answers for an explicitly excluded route
findings.invariant: Never dispatch an excluded route; preserve a unique positive route; conflicting or unrepresentable route scopes clarify

findings.mechanism: Generic train suppression recognizes only direct adjacency to a specific mode
findings.risk: English and multilingual single-mode requests become false multi-mode clarification
findings.invariant: A bounded modifier between Metro/MRTS and its train noun does not create suburban rail; independent local/suburban mentions remain distinct

findings.mechanism: Python word boundaries exclude combining marks
findings.risk: Conjunction substring inside a Hindi word creates a nonexistent extra execution scope
findings.invariant: Only standalone Unicode letter/number/mark-delimited conjunctions coordinate; real multiple scopes remain guarded

findings.mechanism: Negative availability/membership propositions are treated as mode exclusions
findings.risk: A question about a mode loses the queried mode or asks the user to choose it again
findings.invariant: Retain the queried mode in a negative availability/membership proposition; actual avoidance excludes it and defaults never reintroduce it

findings.mechanism: A queued rerun raises at spinner teardown between user and assistant persistence
findings.risk: Orphan user turns, missing clarification state and subsequent inconsistent history
findings.invariant: Persist each accepted query and its captured mode before UI yields; persist its outcome before any post-request yield; resume pre-request interruptions exactly once
